description: Start an AI generation and return its job id at once. mediaType is the family the model catalog groups the model in, and options take the field names the catalog lists for the chosen scene. This spends credits; a price estimate beforehand charges nothing. A stable idempotencyKey on a retry replays the same job instead of billing twice. The job runs in the background, and its status and files are read by its job id.

expectedCredits.description: The credits a price estimate answered for this request. If the price has moved since, nothing is started or charged and the error (price_changed) gives the new price.

mediaType.description: Generation family, e.g. 'image' | 'video' | '3d' | 'music', as the model catalog groups them.

options.description: Model-specific options, as the model catalog lists them (include_inputs). An image preset runs with mediaType "image", scene "image-to-image", options.image (the picture, or the subject then a reference) and options.preset (its id), optionally preset_addons and preset_background; the server then composes the prompt, and prompt holds only extra instructions.

prompt.description: The prompt; with options.preset, only your additional instructions.

name: generate

deduped.description: True when an earlier call with the same idempotency key already started this job: nothing was charged again.

job_id.description: The id of the started job.

outputs.description: How many results this job makes.

status.description: pending and processing are running; success, partial, failed and canceled are final. 'partial' means some outputs finished and the rest were refunded.

title: Start a generation
